summary: Temporary danger area EGD174A activated near EGLC, up to 700 ft above sea level, for drone operations beyond visual line of sight.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD174A ACTIVATED. AIP SUP 093/2026
REFERS. BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI
THE TDA. EMERG SER AND MIL OPS REQUIRING IMMEDIATE ACCESS TO THE
TDA SHOULD CTC HEATHROW RADAR ON 125.625MHZ. FOR OTHER CREWED
ACFT OR VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT OPS ACCESS, CTC THE OPR 72 HR PRIOR
TO OPS COMMENCING ON 01332 319137 OR VIA EMAIL TO
FLIGHTOPS.UK(AT)MATTERNET.COM. FURTHER DETAILS VIA
WWW.NATS-UK.EAD-IT.COM AR-2026-4900/00.
